node.title: List staircase: sup-over-words list size is a monotone integer => unique crossing exists
node.statement: sup_U |Lambda(U, delta)| is nondecreasing and integer-valued in delta, so a unique adjacent crossing of eps*|F| exists unconditionally per row and m. The list-window arithmetic [H/128, H/256] brackets the candidates. Same elementary argument as the MCA side.
